tests.prompt: Ticket 101: Tauhid Zaman wants one Classic Bulldog Tee (CC-TEE-WHITE) in size S. Use the campus-customs MCP server to check whether we have it in stock.

db_check.query: SELECT * FROM inventory WHERE sku='CC-TEE-WHITE' AND size='S'

tests.prompt: Ticket 102: Elm City Properties emailed that rent is due in 2 days. Use the campus-customs MCP server to look up lease 1 and confirm the amount, landlord and due date.

db_check.query: SELECT l.*, d.date_today, CAST(julianday(l.next_due)-julianday(d.date_today) AS INT) AS days FROM leases l, desk d WHERE l.id=1
